systems.country_label: السجل الوطني للسكان; also السجل البيومتري / التسجيل البيومتري, and the deputy's السجل الوطني للوثائق المؤمنة
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Decentralisation and Local Development
systems.tiers: permanent enrolment at the competent centres; 238 local identification and census commissions in all communes since end September 2025; mobile field missions; more than 5.1 million enrolled, from 3.4 million in 2019

note: No fact: the minister's answer of 18 June 2026 is about enrolling citizens in the national population (biometric) register, which is identity; it says the civil status system was modernised and its services digitised but names no event registered and does not say how or where a birth or death is recorded.
